Welcome — glad to help. To get you fully operational with PO routing, our procurement / vendor master process needs the following: (short checklist)

1) Legal business name as it appears on your tax docs (exact casing & punctuation).
2) W-9 (PDF), or W-8 if non-US — PDF preferred.
3) Bank confirmation letter (PDF) for ACH setup — needs bank letterhead, account last 4 digits, and bank contact.
4) Remit address (street, city, state, ZIP) and preferred invoice email for AP.
5) Primary and secondary contacts (name, title, phone, email) for PO receipt and invoice escalation.

Portal options: you can either upload via our vendor portal (preferred) or reply to this thread with the documents. Portal link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cKestrelOnboard (we use the Drive folder for intake drafts).

For ERP mapping / PO channel assignments I've looped in Karthik (AP integrations). Karthik — please confirm whether Kestrel will be routed to the standard ACH lane or needs manual remittance via our BI-pay channel, and whether we should reserve a vendor ID now.

If you can return the docs today, I can start the vendor record and route a test PO to your AP email.
